source.title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning
source.where: App. J, Fig. 24 (c) (search tree, validation scores); test scores from Table 1
source.unit: percentage points on the validation set (D_pareto), n = 300
source.spread_basis: assumed, not measured: the paper prints no rerun spread. The range runs from half the binomial standard error at n = 300 validation items to that standard error, at the scores' mean

held_out.note: the test-set scores the paper prints for the seed and the selected winner: a fresh-task comparison, which is not the estimand (a rerun on the same validation items)

source.note: node ids as printed in the tree; the winner is the tree's top validation score, which matches Fig. 16's test minus generalization gap for this run; the seed's validation score is the same in all four runs of this figure, so a rerun on the same items may move it less than the range assumes
